messages:
Nadia (Sales): Heads up 9: MediCore POC. Customer mandate: process + store in-region only for UK (europe-west2) and Canada (northamerica-northeast1). BYOK required, and they want a list of subprocessors + routing policy confirmation. Can presales/infra/legal advise? @Ravi @Omar @Priya
Ravi (Presales): We can do this but need to pick deployment mode. Hosted standard cannot promise zero control-plane signaling outside regions. Dedicated regional or Private (VPC) are the options. Need to confirm whether control-plane in-region is mandatory or 'data-plane only'.
Omar (Infra): Quick tech note: inference and storage can be pinned to those two regions. Control-plane: we have two choices: spin up regional control-plane (adds ~3-5k infra time) or use Private with customer's VPC (no control-plane egress). BYOK: supported via HSM import; customer can bring keys to our partner HSM in-region.
Priya (Legal): Subprocessors: cloud provider(s) in-region, KMS/HSM partner, support/ops vendor (we can route support logs regionally), and monitoring (we can offer EU/CA-hosted tenant). I'll prepare attestation language. If they demand absolute zero third-country transfers, call out cert revocation/OCSP and time-sync NTP as potential exceptions.
Jin (AE): Pricing ask from customer: how much for a 6-week POC (small scale) vs a pilot-to-prod path? Need a ballpark for procurement.
Ravi (Presales): Ballpark (very rough): dedicated regional slices for POC ~ $11k/month (includes ops support & small reserved GPU capacity). If they pick Private VPC: one-time integration estimate $10k + $6k/month infra licensing. If they want regional control-plane as hosted add-on: one-off ~$4k. Total for 6-week POC likely in $12k-$20k range depending on options.
Nadia (Sales): Can we get a short config snippet for procurement + a brief 'exceptions' list? Also they want explicit subprocessor names they can share with security.
Omar (Infra): Config snippet to forward:
```yaml
deployment:
  mode: dedicated-regional
  regions:
    - europe-west2
    - northamerica-northeast1
  control_plane: regional (optional add-on)
  byok: true
  kms_mode: partner-hsm-in-region
  telemetry: regional-only
  fallback_policy: reject-external-egress
```
Exceptions we need to surface: OCSP/CRL for cert validation may hit public CA endpoints; package repository pulls (apt/yum) during provisioning; time sync and emergency support tunnels (rare) may route outside region unless you opt for Private with strict egress controls.
Ravi (Presales): Subprocessor list (initial): Google Cloud (eu, ca regions), Thales/Cavium HSM partner (regional deployments), Monitoring provider (EU/CA tenant option), PagerDuty (support alerts routing), CDN vendor (edge requests only). Omar will export the definitive list for the security team.
Priya (Legal): I'll attach DPA addendum + a draft subprocessor attestation. If MediCore requires 'no-third-country transfers', we must get a signed risk acceptance for the cert/CA caveat or build a local CA proxy (adds ~1 week eng time).
Omar (Infra): Action item: I'll produce subproc export + egress diagram and a short note on what telemetry/metrics look like (48-72h). Also flag: regional dedicated capacity ~10-18% cost uplift vs global pooling; control-plane add-on is a material one-off.
Jin (AE): Timeline: if SOW signed this week and they accept regional-control-plane as add-on, can we be live for POC in 21 days?
Ravi (Presales): Yes, roughly: day 0-5 BYOK & HSM prep; day 6-12 infra provisioning & control-plane; day 13-21 smoke tests + onboarding. Contingent on customer providing cert/key material promptly.
Nadia (Sales): Great. I'll share this config + ballpark and ask for signed acknowledgement on cert/OCSP caveat. Will loop back after customer review. Thanks y'all :pray:
